definition.name: Impressionist gardens
definition.description: Gardens, parks, flower fields and orchards by the Impressionists and the painters and printmakers around them, chosen for a bright, unhurried screen.

works.alt_text: A field of red poppies stretches under a blue sky with soft clouds, lined with tall poplars and round green trees.
A sunny gravel path curves through a city park past green lawns, palms and flower beds, with a woman resting on a bench.
A sunlit orchard of young blossoming trees beside a pink-walled farmhouse, with a path through bright green grass.
Pink and white water lilies float on a pond that reflects green and violet foliage, painted in loose, layered strokes.
Terraced orchards and garden plots in autumn yellows, oranges and greens slope down a hillside beside a grey path.
A woman in a white dress sits reading on a green lawn, with a fan and a parasol beside her and a meadow beyond.
A young woman in white sits on a stone wall beside a small tree of pink peach blossom, with green hills behind.
A small blue pond lies among rocks, grasses and white wild roses, with the sea and a low island beyond.
Crowds of children and adults in summer clothes stroll down a broad stone terrace staircase in a leafy park.

placard.title: The Terrace Bridge, Central Park
placard.creator: Maurice Prendergast (American, 1858-1924)
placard.medium: Watercolor, over graphite, on ivory wove paper

works.alt_text: Children in white and pink dresses dance around ribboned maypoles on a wide green lawn in a park.
Women in pale robes walk beneath tall blue cypress trees beside a bay with sailing boats, all drawn in coloured dots.
A nursemaid in a blue cape watches a child playing beside a red toy horse under chestnut trees, drawn in soft coloured dots.
Ladies stroll past a round bed of white flowers on a pale lawn in a city garden, with white pigeons in the foreground.
A sunlit stone terrace with a row of pale columns looks onto a garden of bright green leaves and shrubs.

placard.title: Tarragona Terrace and Garden
placard.creator: John Singer Sargent (American, 1856-1925)
placard.medium: Watercolor and opaque watercolor with printed paper fragments over traces of graphite on ivory wove paper

works.alt_text: A small girl in white walks down broad stone steps through a green park lined with tall trees.
Young women in long pale dresses play blindman's buff on a park lawn, one of them blindfolded at the centre, with autumn trees beyond.
Figures, carriages and a dog move along a sandy avenue under bare trees, in a printed tan and brown haze.
Women in dark shawls walk through a public garden past a red fence, a green bush and two cone-shaped orange shrubs.
Women in pale draped dresses sail toy boats in a round pond among white-trunked trees and potted orange trees.
Families sit on chairs and stroll beneath tall trees in a city garden, with a fountain and buildings beyond, in black and white.
A mother and three children sit close together on a garden bench under dark leaves, in a soft black and white print.
People sit at tables in the dappled shade of tall trees in a beer garden, drawn in dense black lines.

placard.title: Beer Garden in Rosenheim
placard.creator: Max Liebermann (German, 1847-1935) (later published by Pan (German and French, 1895-1900))

works.alt_text: A mother and children gather around a round table on a vine-covered terrace above a valley with cypress trees and a distant city.
A rounded tree with drooping branches stands in a garden of tall grasses and shrubs, drawn in bold black reed-pen strokes.

placard.title: Weeping Tree
placard.creator: Vincent van Gogh (Dutch, 1853-1890)
placard.medium: Reed pen and black-brown ink, with black chalk on off-white wove paper
